title: Local Finance Export Vault
user: Privacy-minded individuals moving between budgeting tools who need to preserve and inspect their own financial exports before an app, pricing tier, or sync service changes.
smallest_useful_product: Offline vault that imports common budget exports, snapshots an immutable manifest and hashes, maps fields into a documented neutral schema, and produces a readable migration packet.
success_measure: A user can import two exports from different tools and produce a validated archive plus field-mapping report without any financial row leaving the device.
constraints: Encrypt local archive option; no credentials; transparent schema versioning; never claim regulatory-grade accounting or tax correctness.
summary: Preserve budget exports and make a clear migration packet on your device.
